crates.name: ripgrep
crates.description:
ripgrep is a line-oriented search tool that recursively searches the current
directory for a regex pattern while respecting gitignore rules. ripgrep has
first class support on Windows, macOS and Linux.

crates.name: gist-search
crates.description: Indexed code search for Rust - ripgrep-parity regex search over a persisted trigram index, with ranked definition-first results.

crates.name: cgx-core
crates.description: Core library for cgx, the Rust equivalent of uvx or npx for running Rust crates quickly and easily
